recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒內有眾多脂肪空泡與穿插其間的紡錘形間質細胞、淡藍色纖維狀基質，並散在深黑至黃綠色的含鐵血黃素顆粒與折光性碎屑，屬骨髓正常間質成分（脂肪細胞、網狀細胞、含鐵巨噬細胞）。
features: Marrow particle with abundant adipocytes forming clustered clear vacuoles
Interspersed spindle-shaped stromal cells with oval nuclei and pale blue fibrillary cytoplasm
Dark black and yellow-green coarse granules consistent with hemosiderin within macrophages
Refractile yellow-brown amorphous material adjacent to fat, likely hemosiderin or artifact
Admixed hematopoietic cells with oval nuclei along the stromal network
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a particle composed of numerous adipocytes with an interlacing network of spindle-shaped stromal cells and pale blue fibrillary matrix. Scattered dark black to yellow-green coarse granules, consistent with hemosiderin within macrophages, and refractile yellow-brown material are present. Admixed hematopoietic cells show no atypia, and no cohesive tumor clusters or granulomas are identified. Findings represent normal marrow stromal elements, including adipocytes, reticular cells, and iron-laden macrophages; storage iron should be graded on Prussian blue stain.

ddx.vs: Tumor forms cohesive clusters with nuclear pleomorphism and molding rather than a bland stromal network.
Gaucher cells are large histiocytes with wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm and a small eccentric nucleus, unlike spindle stromal cells.
Spindle mast cells contain metachromatic purple granules and show tryptase/CD117/CD25 positivity.
Granulomas show cohesive epithelioid histiocytes with elongated slipper-shaped nuclei, sometimes with giant cells, rather than adipocyte-rich stroma.
